scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the paid Red Prairie Propane refill order before today’s manual dispatch window controls the Friday route.
Emerging Need: The refill checkout begins with a card authorization, but that same order stops during route validation and self-service edits lock.
Decision Context: Provider notices identify the stuck order, hold, and cutoff; the stored propane profile supplies the account, tank-location detail, dispatch route, and standard-route limit needed to distinguish continuation from a new paid service.
Consequence: Timely documentation can preserve the existing refill order; after dispatch closes, the order remains on refund review and cannot reach Friday’s route.

parameter.title: Check propane refill before Friday route
parameter.content: Use the regular Red Prairie Propane account if the tank refill order needs dispatch clearance before the afternoon route cutoff.

parameter.description: Card authorization for standard propane refill order RPP-5532

parameter.subject: Refill order RPP-5532 received — route validation pending
parameter.body: Your standard refill order RPP-5532 has been received and the card authorization is attached. The order is waiting for route validation before it can be placed on Friday’s truck. Please do not start a duplicate paid order while validation is pending.

parameter.content: Order RPP-5532 stopped during route validation: the tank location in the portal profile does not match the driver map. Self-service edits are locked on this paid order. Manual dispatch review must clear the location by 1:45 PM today for the Friday route.

parameter.subject: RPP-5532 missed today’s manual dispatch review
parameter.body: The manual review window for refill order RPP-5532 closed at 1:45 PM without location clearance. The paid order will not be loaded onto Friday’s route and remains in refund-review hold until the next business-day batch.
